intro.heading: Get in touch
intro.body: One address, read by a person.

email.heading: Email
email.body: For questions about your account, bug reports, or anything to do with your data.

privacy.heading: Your data
privacy.body: To ask for a copy of what is stored about you, or for it to be erased, write to the same address. What is stored, and for how long, is set out in the privacy policy.

security.heading: Found a security problem?
security.body: Write to the same address and say what you found. Please give us a chance to fix it before you publish it.
